Here are the descriptions of the plots, following your guidelines:

Both plots share a common x-axis labeled “Steps” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with tick marks every 100. Both plots also share a common y-axis labeled “Training Rewards” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.4 for the top plot and 0 to 0.2 for the bottom plot, with tick marks every 0.1.

The first plot, titled "Easy Training Set", displays two lines. The first line is blue, without markers, and represents “Llama-On-Policy-Easy”. It begins at approximately (0, 0.18) and steadily increases to approximately (500, 0.36). The second line is red, without markers, and represents “Llama-LUFFY-Easy”. It begins at approximately (0, 0.05) and increases to approximately (500, 0.33), exhibiting some fluctuations in between.

The second plot, titled "Hard Training Set", also displays two lines. The first line is blue, without markers, and represents “Llama-On-Policy-Hard”. It starts at approximately (0, 0.02), increases to approximately (100, 0.12), and then fluctuates around 0.15 until approximately (500, 0.17). The second line is red, without markers, and represents “Llama-LUFFY-Hard”; this line starts at approximately (0, 0.02) and increases to approximately (500, 0.21), with several oscillations occurring between those points.
